subject: POC Success Criteria & KPI Follow-up (Atlas Payments)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@atlaspayments.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Success Criteria & Next Steps (Atlas)

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to meet the team. As promised, I put together a concise recap and proposed POC success criteria so we can align on scope and timelines. Attached: 20260803-Atlas-POC-scope.docx and a short SOW.

Recap / primary goals:
- Validate model quality for customer support automation (intent classification + short-form reply generation).
- Meet latency & throughput targets inside your inference window (see KPIs below).
- Confirm unit economics (cost/token) with realistic traffic patterns.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms at target message sizes (avg 120 tokens).
- Throughput: sustain 80 req/s with 100ms batching SLA (peak 200 req/s for bursts).
- Cost: inference cost <= $0.0009 per token (target to justify economics vs current provider).
- Quality: Automated NPS-like satisfaction >= 4.0 on human evaluation (sample of 300 replies) and < 5% hallucination rate on labeled prompts.

Evaluation plan (high-level):
1) Week 0: access & credentials, sample dataset share.
2) Week 1: integration of SDK + baseline smoke tests.
3) Week 2: performance tuning & latency benchmarks (we'll run our latency-benchmarks-q3.csv tests).
4) Week 3: quality evals (human-in-the-loop and automated metrics).
5) Week 4: final report and decision meeting.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Jordan (POC lead), Aditya (SE, perf tuning), Monica (CS for onboarding).
- Atlas: Sam (technical lead), Priya (product owner), Liam (ops).

Next steps:
- Can you share a representative sample of 1k anonymized tickets by EOD Wed?
- I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Aditya and your ops team for Thu.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlaspayments.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & Next Steps (Atlas)

Thanks Jordan — good summary. A few quick notes from our side:

- We can extract a 1k anonymized ticket sample and share by Wed EOD — will scrub PII.
- Latency targets look reasonable but want to confirm p95 at 350ms includes network egress to our EU region (we have a subset of traffic routed there). Most traffic is US but we have ~15% EU.
- On cost, our finance gate is at <= $0.001/token for this volume — can you confirm if your estimate includes caching and batching benefits?

I'll be on the kickoff Thu at 10am ET. Priya will run point on acceptance criteria and Liam will handle infra/network questions.

Sam

Sam Carter
Director, Product Ops | Atlas Payments
sam.carter@atlaspayments.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@atlaspayments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlaspayments.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & Next Steps (Atlas)

Great questions Sam — quick answers: 
- EU traffic: we'll run tests from both us-west and eu-west nodes; p95 targets are per-region unless you want a global p95 (we can do both).
- Cost estimate: the $0.0009/token is a baseline with recommended batching + caching; we'll instrument the POC to measure effective token cost.
- Network: please have Liam share any IP allowlist or VPC settings before the kickoff so we can pre-configure.

I've attached the latency-benchmarks-q3.csv we typically run for perf validation. During Week 2 we'll also test with production-like concurrency to validate cache hit ratios.

- Aditya

Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@atlaspayments.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & Next Steps (Atlas)

All sounds good. Two refinement requests from our PM perspective:
1) For quality evaluation, can we define the rubric? Suggested: correct intent classification rate >= 92%, appropriate reply rate >= 88% on a 300-item human eval.
2) For hallucination definition: any generated content that asserts unsupported facts about customer accounts or policies should be counted. We want <5% on that measure.

We'll also need a short data processing agreement for the anonymized tickets — I'll have procurement share a redline if needed.

Priya

Priya Singh
Product Manager | Atlas Payments
priya.singh@atlaspayments.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@atlaspayments.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & Next Steps (Atlas)

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation after internal sync:

- We'll treat p95 as region-specific and report both US and EU values.
- We'll instrument token accounting and include caching impact in the cost/token calculation; target the finance threshold of $0.001/token and flag if we exceed.
- Quality rubric: we'll adopt Priya's suggested thresholds (intent >=92%, reply appropriateness >=88%) and run a 300-sample human eval. We'll also provide automated metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity) as secondary signals.
- Data handling: Monica will own the DPA/privacy checklist and will coordinate with your procurement for the redline.

Kickoff is scheduled Thu 6 Aug 2026 at 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET. Calendar invite sent. Please confirm the ticket dump by Wed EOD so Aditya can start integration on Thu.

Action items summary:
- Atlas: provide anonymized 1k tickets (Sam/Priya) — due Wed EOD (5 Aug).
- Atlas: share any allowlist/VPC details (Liam) — before Thu kickoff.
- Redwood: onboarding + perf harness (Aditya) — action during Week 1/2.
- Redwood: DPA checklist (Monica) — share DPA template and next steps.

I'll follow up with the POC plan doc in Drive and a HubSpot update (deal ATL-2026-07-1123).

Best — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
